activation_conditions: Independent review of the selected L2 temporal and lifecycle-provenance design.
Explicit Owner approval of this draft before production implementation planning.
A separate implementation packet pins the exact local API/version and specifies bounded asynchronous live-artifact mechanics without changing this semantic payload.
evidence_limit: Design semantics only. Not production implementation or runtime evidence.

hash_spec.canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sort object keys by Unicode code point; preserve array order; strings use JSON escaping only as required for quotes, backslash, and control characters; only null, booleans, strings, and base-10 integers are permitted; reject floats, non-finite values, and unpaired surrogates; no BOM, insignificant whitespace, or trailing newline in hashed bytes.
hash_spec.digest_input: exact canonical bytes of semantic_payload only; digest is not inserted into its own payload

configuration_binding.unselected_profile_serialization: omit member; do not serialize null; preserve existing bytes/hash semantics

lifecycle_barrier_provenance.artifact: live internal admitted lifecycle copy; callback validates/copies/enqueues without waiting for file; bounded storage and atomic publication; include schema/version, invocation/collector identity, endpoint binding, original payload/provenance, receive-time fields, sequence, and structured validity/failure
lifecycle_barrier_provenance.artifact_availability: written without waiting for Gate-B completion, C++ finalize, or navigation result
lifecycle_barrier_provenance.message_provenance: C++ subscription callback receives rclcpp::MessageInfo; read underlying rmw_message_info_t.publisher_gid and compare to exactly one pinned publisher endpoint; pin once per invocation and collector session; no rebind
lifecycle_barrier_provenance.python_ingress: Python temporal gating uses only admitted lifecycle copy; direct Python callback is not per-message-GID verified
lifecycle_barrier_provenance.revision_semantics: SafetyLifecycleCore._set transition increments sequence; ordinary monotonic refresh does not; header.stamp and barrier_stamp are not revision
lifecycle_barrier_provenance.trust_boundary: operational provenance in controlled simulation campaign only; not cryptographic authentication and not GID-to-PID proof

phase_a.context_change: active attempt context change invalidates before action
phase_a.invalid_clock: zero/unavailable/invalid ROS time pins no t_A and sends no action; existing steady campaign deadline continues
phase_a.planner_action_cardinality: at most one ComputePathToPose action per attempt; query re-arm does not resend
phase_a.planner_stamp: ROS time sampled at request send; distinct from prerequisite t_A
phase_a.rollback: terminally invalidates attempt; later clock increase does not resurrect it
phase_a.t_A: positive ROS time sampled at first valid trigger consumption; pin once; no file mtime or wall-time substitution
phase_a.tf_query: nonblocking exact-time poll at pinned t_A; target never moves; no latest, zero-time, or now-minus-offset fallback
phase_a.trigger: valid JSON trigger has no ROS header; consume valid trigger once

phase_b.checks: freshness at acquisition and commit; after transform reread ROS time, steady time, active identity, barrier revision/event, and path context; check cutoff ordering, deadline, frames, provenance, generation/epoch, and existing acceptance
phase_b.future_information: reject records later than applicable cutoff; preserve original timestamps/provenance
phase_b.inputs: pin eligible scan, odometry, lifecycle, receipt, returned path, and correlation records at t_vector; no future/post-cutoff input and no implicit replacement by latest
phase_b.rollback: clears pending snapshot and terminally invalidates attempt; no resurrection

timestamps.t_commit: ROS time read after transform; commit provenance and final validation time
timestamps.t_tf: exact ROS stamp of the pinned odometry record; t_tf equals t_odom
timestamps.t_vector: immutable ROS cutoff selected at sample acquisition

phase_b.transform: successful exact lookup required even after can_transform true; lookup exception cannot commit; preserve cause; deep-copy transform request and do not mutate raw path

returned_path.admission: only SUCCEEDED result for exact pending ComputePathToPose request/action goal
returned_path.expiry: no later than existing steady campaign deadline
returned_path.path_sequence: adapter admission counter incremented only when new path is accepted; not claimed to be a Nav2 field
returned_path.receipt_time: steady time recorded at callback admission
returned_path.storage: immutable copy of returned path and poses
